name: smartleave-system
description: Smart Leave Notification System - Monorepo root

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,STUDENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev" "npm --prefix student run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,ADMIN,STUDENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix admin run dev" "npm --prefix student run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix student install
